subject: Cannot viewClade if there is a collapsed clade inside

messages.author: 389d046fc2d602cf
messages.subject: Cannot viewClade if there is a collapsed clade inside
parts:
Hello Guangchuang Yu,

Thanks for your help in all the topics I have posted recently.

I am trying to reduce a tree with viewClade, but I have a collapsed clade in there. It gives me an error. Here goes an example with a random tree:

t <- ggtree(rtree(15)) + geom_tiplab() + geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip, label=node))
t <- t  %>% ggtree::collapse(node=28) # Any node not very close to the root
viewClade(t, node=20) # Node including collapsed node plus others

Error:

Error in if (zero_range(range)) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


Is it possible to correct that such that I can get a figure with a smaller clade including a collapsed clade?

Thanks!

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Cannot viewClade if there is a collapsed clade inside
parts:
it is supported in devel branch (>=1.9.2), see also https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/ggtree/issues/137.

messages.subject: Re: Cannot viewClade if there is a collapsed clade inside
parts: In your example, the collapsed clade 28 is not part of the clade 20 which was cur in viewClade, so the example doesn't work. That's because the tree is generated randomly. You would have to choose a clade within another clade to collapse to see the problem I pointed out.
